findings.text: non-blocking: the after-snapshot is now bounded while the recorded baseline is unrestricted, so status_digest compares digests over different entry universes and will differ whenever any undeclared untracked directory exists, defeating the `if not status_changed: continue` short-circuit the digest exists to provide; the verdict stays correct because the charge filter is unchanged, but every tree now pays the set difference the short-circuit previously skipped.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 930eccbb3a — 8020d97a93 changes reckon/crew/routing.py (+58/-16) and reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py (+18/-? reordering) and adds tests/test_boundary_check_reads_only_declared_roots.py, and bc7e0af26e adds only the landing fragment; nothing is added that the goal does not imply.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when has three clauses; the section's test passes with its negative control (gate/logs/negative-control.log fails on `assert 2.7001322358846664 <= (2 * 0.024330511689186096)` at 930eccbb3a and passes at bc7e0af26e, gate/logs/focused-head-arm.log 58 passed EXIT=0) and the ruff delta is recorded, but the importer-population clause is met only for the six boundary-exercising files and not for the 118-file population the done_when names, and the focused arms ran in place rather than on the all_debug partition the done_when names.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a promotion's boundary check does not walk untracked trees; reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:810 now passes the run's declared roots as untracked_roots, and reckon/crew/routing.py:663 narrows the `git status --untracked-files=all` read to those literal pathspecs while every dispatch-time caller (promotion_records.py:1348, dispatch_launch.py:3930, dispatching/launch.py:987) keeps the unrestricted default it records the baseline with.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the head arm (58 passed, EXIT=0, revision bc7e0af26e, module resolved in the tree), the base arm (3 failed / 55 passed, EXIT=1, all three failures in the new test file), the negative control, and states the wider importer arm under blockers as unmeasured rather than claiming it.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the fence in the source prompt (reckon/crew/routing.py, reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py, tests/, the landing fragment); every path in the two reviewed commits is inside it and the manifest's changed_paths lists exactly those four.

justifications.durability: tests/test_boundary_check_reads_only_declared_roots.py:176 reddens at 930eccbb3a by 111x when the bound is absent, and the absence assertion at :199 carries its positive control at :202, showing the unrestricted read in the same process sees what the bounded one omits.
justifications.evidence: gate/logs/negative-control.log and gate/logs/focused-head-arm.log record both arms and the negative control, but the 118-file importer population the done_when names is unmeasured (manifest blockers) and the focused arms ran in place rather than on all_debug.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/routing.py:713 follows the subprocess and list-argument form the module already uses, though the fabricated subprocess.CompletedProcess at :704 is a less idiomatic way to answer the empty-root case than returning the tree state directly.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:810 bounds the read with the same declared_roots tuple the charge filter at :889 already uses, so the read and the refusal cannot disagree.
justifications.reuse: the bounded read extends the existing owner (_tree_state and _repository_tree_snapshot) rather than forking it; a capability search over reckon/ for `untracked-files` found only unrestricted readers in ledger.py:2891, checkout_trust.py:740, dispatch_sessions.py:1542 and gc.py:844, none of which owns a bounded variant.
justifications.scope_discipline: the only paths in 930eccbb3a..bc7e0af26e are reckon/crew/routing.py, reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py, tests/test_boundary_check_reads_only_declared_roots.py and the granted landing fragment.
